title.zh: 币安遭大规模黑客攻击，公司承担损失并冻结部分被盗资金
title.en: Binance hit by large-scale hack, losses covered by company reserves

current_state.zh: 币安仍在处理这起创纪录的约 63 亿美元黑客事件，已用公司资金补充约 90% 被盗资产；调查披露攻击者通过 EIP-7702 绕过正常审批控制取得热钱包执行权限并使用自毁机制清除痕迹，币安暂停提现以重建系统并目标 40 小时内恢复；FBI 已公开将攻击归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor。
current_state.en: Binance is still handling the record ~$6.3 billion hack and has replenished about 90% of stolen assets from company funds; the investigation disclosed that attackers used EIP-7702 to bypass normal approval controls and gain hot-wallet execution authority and used self-destruct mechanisms to erase traces, while Binance paused withdrawals to rebuild systems with a 40-hour restoration target; the FBI has publicly attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor.

updates.title_zh: 币安将63亿美元被盗事件归咎于工程师被入侵的笔记本电脑
updates.title_en: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance初步调查称，攻击者可能通过被入侵的DevOps工程师笔记本电脑进入服务容器并提交未经授权的提币交易，未发现私钥泄露证据；Binance将影响估计上调至约63亿美元，并称已冻结约30亿美元资产，计划用SAFU和公司资金覆盖损失、撤销受影响地址授权并更新储备证明。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance's preliminary investigation says attackers may have used a compromised DevOps engineer laptop to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence of private-key leakage; Binance raised the estimated impact to about $6.3 billion, said about $3 billion was frozen, and plans to cover losses via SAFU and company funds, revoke the affected address authorization, and publish updated Proof of Reserves.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance事件仍在调查中；初步指向DevOps设备被入侵和签名基础设施被滥用，而非私钥泄露。影响估计约63亿美元，约30亿美元已冻结，存取款曾暂停，受影响地址授权已撤销，损失将由SAFU和公司资金覆盖，详细技术复盘待发布。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance incident remains under investigation; preliminary findings point to a compromised DevOps device and signing-infrastructure misuse rather than private-key leakage. Estimated impact is about $6.3 billion, about $3 billion has been frozen, deposits/withdrawals were temporarily suspended, the affected address authorization was revoked, losses will be covered by SAFU and company funds, and a detailed technical post-mortem is pending.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance's preliminary investigation into its $6.3B breach points to a hacked DevOps engineer's laptop used to access internal infrastructure and push unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence found of a private-key leak.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance's preliminary investigation into its $6.3B breach points to a hacked DevOps engineer's laptop used to access internal infrastructure and push unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence found of a private-key leak.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Blockaid detailed how an attacker gained control of Binance's Binance 14 hot wallet by submitting 50 EIP-7702 authorizations with different nonces in a single Type-4 transaction, with the one matching authorization delegating the account to a malicious contract capable of sweeping ETH and ERC-20 tokens while leaving 1 ETH for gas.

updates.what_changed_zh: Blockaid 分析指出，币安黑客事件的根本原因是签名系统被入侵，EIP-7702 可能帮助攻击者绕过安全检查并在单次交易中清空钱包，但并非攻击的必要条件。
updates.what_changed_en: Blockaid analysis indicated that compromised signing systems were the root cause of the Binance hack, and EIP-7702 may have helped attackers bypass security checks and drain wallets in a single sweep, though it was not necessary for the attack.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；确认存在多个入侵点，约30亿美元资产已冻结，损失将由公司承担；分析人士归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor。最新链上分析显示攻击者关联地址持有18,270枚BTC和508,621枚ETH。安全公司 Blockaid 指出签名系统被入侵是根本原因，EIP-7702 可能放大了损失但并非必要条件。

New onchain analysis shows attacker-linked addresses holding 18,270 BTC and 508,621 ETH. Security firm Blockaid indicated that compromised signing systems were the root cause, and EIP-7702 may have amplified losses but was not necessary.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance confirmed a $6.3 billion hack — the largest in crypto history — and pledged to cover losses, while Blockaid said compromised signing systems were the root cause and that Ethereum's EIP-7702 upgrade may have helped attackers bypass security checks and drain wallets in a single sweep.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance confirmed a $6.3 billion hack — the largest in crypto history — and pledged to cover losses, while Blockaid said compromised signing systems were the root cause and that Ethereum's EIP-7702 upgrade may have helped attackers bypass security checks and drain wallets in a single sweep.

updates.what_changed_en: Binance confirmed it is working with the FBI and other law enforcement to recover stolen assets, saying industry partners have frozen about $3 billion and that it has reserved over $6.34 billion in company funds, $5 billion of which is in the exact stolen tokens.

updates.title_zh: 【币安联席 CEO：将于下周一前公布完整储备金证明】
updates.title_en: 【币安联席 CEO：将于下周一前公布完整储备金证明】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安联席 CEO Richard Teng 表示，币安将在下周一前发布完整储备金证明报告，并可能先发布初步版本；用户提现仍按原计划有望在周日前恢复。他还披露攻击者利用 EIP-7702 获取对一个热钱包的链上执行授权，绕过常规审批流程，并发现更多入侵点及自毁机制。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said Binance will release a complete proof-of-reserves report by Monday, possibly with an initial version beforehand, and user withdrawals remain expected to resume by Sunday. He also disclosed that attackers used EIP-7702 to gain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, bypassing normal approval processes, and that additional breach points and self-destruct mechanisms were found.

updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said a complete proof-of-reserves report will be released by Monday and user withdrawals are expected to resume by Sunday; attackers used EIP-7702 to obtain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, and additional breach points and self-destruct mechanisms were found. Binance has reserved over $6.34B in company funds to cover losses, including $5B in affected tokens, is buying the remainder through market and OTC channels, and is working with law enforcement to recover assets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says the exchange will release a complete proof-of-reserves report by Monday and restore withdrawals by Sunday, after attackers used EIP-7702 to gain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, with more than $6.34B in corporate funds set aside to fully cover losses.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says the exchange will release a complete proof-of-reserves report by Monday and restore withdrawals by Sunday, after attackers used EIP-7702 to gain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, with more than $6.34B in corporate funds set aside to fully cover losses.

updates.what_changed_zh: 一份链上分析解释了攻击者如何通过获取 EIP-7702 授权——在 50 个已签名委托中暴力破解 nonce 值——来清空币安的 Binance 14 热钱包，进而安装一个清扫合约，随后转移了该钱包的以太币和代币。
updates.what_changed_en: An on-chain analysis explains how attackers drained Binance's Binance 14 hot wallet by obtaining EIP-7702 authorizations — brute-forcing nonce values across 50 signed delegations — to install a sweeper contract that then moved the wallet's ether and tokens.

updates.title_zh: 64 亿美元币安黑客攻击后，马斯克与 CZ 就 SpaceX 股份爆发争执
updates.title_en: Elon Musk, CZ Trade Blows Over SpaceX Shares After $6.4B Binance Hack
updates.what_changed_zh: TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将币安约64亿美元黑客攻击归因于朝鲜关联黑客组织 TraderTraitor；同时 CZ 公开回应马斯克对币安事件的嘲讽，币安联席 CEO Yi He 表示公司年收入足以覆盖损失、无需出售 SpaceX 持股。
updates.what_changed_en: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the ~$6.4B Binance hack to North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor; separately, CZ publicly rebuked Elon Musk over his mockery of Binance, and co-CEO Yi He said annual revenue is sufficient to cover losses without selling SpaceX shares.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；调查机构 TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将攻击归因于朝鲜关联组织 TraderTraitor；币安已预留超过63.4亿美元公司资金覆盖损失，并继续与执法机构合作追回资产；CZ 与马斯克就事件公开交锋，币安联席 CEO Yi He 表示无需出售 SpaceX 持股即可覆盖损失。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the attack to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor; Binance has reserved over $6.34B in company funds to cover losses and continues working with law enforcement to recover assets; CZ and Musk publicly clashed over the incident, with co-CEO Yi He saying Binance does not need to sell SpaceX shares to cover losses.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance co-founder CZ publicly rebuked Elon Musk amid fallout from a $6.4 billion exchange hack, as Binance confirmed it reserved more than $6.34 billion to cover losses and investigators attributed the attack to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor.

updates.title_zh: Binance 黑客攻击：为何比特币未像 2018 年那样暴跌
updates.title_en: Binance Hack: Why Bitcoin Didn't Crash Like It Did in 2018
updates.what_changed_zh: Decrypt 报道补充了市场影响与资金追回细节：比特币较美联储决议后水平仅下跌约4%–6%，约13亿美元杠杆头寸被清算；攻击者仍持有约42万ETH和18,270 BTC（约24亿美元，无法被稳定币发行方冻结）；币安称约30亿美元已冻结，并正通过公开市场和场外交易买入缺失代币，提现预计约45小时内恢复。
updates.what_changed_en: Decrypt added market-impact and recovery details: Bitcoin fell only about 4%–6% from its post-Fed level, roughly $1.3 billion in leveraged bets were liquidated; the attacker still holds about 420,000 ETH and 18,270 BTC (~$2.4 billion that stablecoin issuers cannot freeze); Binance says about $3 billion is frozen and it is buying missing tokens on the open market and over the counter, with withdrawals expected to resume in about 45 hours.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63–64亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；FBI 与特勤局参与调查；TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将攻击归因于朝鲜关联组织 TraderTraitor；Circle 与 Tether 分别冻结约8.23亿美元 USDC 和约9.751亿美元 USDT；币安称约30亿美元已冻结、正通过公开市场和场外交易买入缺失代币，提现预计约45小时内恢复；公司已预留超过63.4亿美元覆盖损失。市场反应相对有限，比特币较美联储决议后水平下跌约4%–6%，约13亿美元杠杆头寸被清算；攻击者仍持有约42万ETH和18,270 BTC（约24亿美元，无法被稳定币发行方冻结）。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3–6.4B hack remains under investigation; the FBI and Secret Service are involved; TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the attack to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor; Circle and Tether froze about $823M in USDC and $975.1M in USDT respectively; Binance says about $3B is frozen, it is buying missing tokens on the open market and over the counter, and withdrawals are expected to resume in about 45 hours; the company has reserved over $6.34B to cover losses. Market reaction has been relatively limited: Bitcoin is down about 4%–6% from its post-Fed level, roughly $1.3B in leveraged bets were liquidated, and the attacker still holds about 420,000 ETH and 18,270 BTC (~$2.4B that stablecoin issuers cannot freeze).
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance confirmed a record $6.4 billion hack, the largest crypto theft to date, while Bitcoin fell only about 4-6% as withdrawals were paused and Binance earmarked over $6.34 billion to cover losses.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance confirmed a record $6.4 billion hack, the largest crypto theft to date, while Bitcoin fell only about 4-6% as withdrawals were paused and Binance earmarked over $6.34 billion to cover losses.

updates.title_zh: CFTC 主席：Binance 黑客攻击表明离岸交易所需要美国监管
updates.title_en: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
updates.what_changed_zh: CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 公开以币安约64亿美元黑客事件为由，推动对离岸加密交易所实施美国联邦监管；同时币安表示调查发现“更多入侵点”，CEO Richard Teng 称攻击过程更复杂，并非仅利用一名工程师的权限。
updates.what_changed_en: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig publicly cited Binance's ~$6.4 billion hack to argue for U.S. federal oversight of offshore crypto exchanges; separately, Binance said its investigation uncovered “additional points of breach,” with CEO Richard Teng calling it a more complex attack process that did not simply use one engineer's permissions.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约64亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；FBI 与特勤局参与，TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将其归因于朝鲜关联组织 TraderTraitor；Circle 与 Tether 分别冻结约8.23亿美元 USDC 和约9.751亿美元 USDT；币安称约30亿美元已冻结、正买入缺失代币，并已预留超过63.4亿美元覆盖损失；最新调查显示除被入侵的 DevOps 工程师笔记本电脑外还存在“更多入侵点”，CFTC 主席借此推动离岸交易所接受美国监管。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.4B hack remains under investigation; the FBI and Secret Service are involved, and TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed it to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor; Circle and Tether froze about $823M in USDC and $975.1M in USDT respectively; Binance says about $3B is frozen, it is buying missing tokens, and it has reserved over $6.34B to cover losses; the latest investigation indicates “additional points of breach” beyond the compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, and the CFTC chair is citing the hack to push for U.S. oversight of offshore exchanges.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said Binance's roughly $6.4 billion hack proves the need for U.S. oversight of offshore exchanges as he promoted the agency's proposed crypto-market rules, while Binance reportedly found additional breach points.
updates.detailed_summary_en: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said Binance's roughly $6.4 billion hack proves the need for U.S. oversight of offshore exchanges as he promoted the agency's proposed crypto-market rules, while Binance reportedly found additional breach points.
updates.background_zh: CFTC于2026年10月5日发布《预先规则制定通知》，就针对加密资产零售商品交易的定制化监管框架公开征求意见，截止日期为2026年10月20日。在《清晰法案》在参议院停滞之后，该机构加快推进自身规则制定，并另行澄清了美国用户接入离岸加密交易所的相关规则。
updates.background_en: The CFTC published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking on Oct. 5, 2026, seeking public comment on a fit-for-purpose framework for crypto-asset retail commodity transactions, with comments due Oct. 20, 2026. The agency has pressed ahead with its own rulemaking after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate, and has separately moved to clarify rules on U.S. access to offshore crypto exchanges.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于市场准入与托管标准：若离岸交易所可通过"联邦选项"在CFTC注册，美国用户获取离岸流动性的条件，以及这些平台面临的网络安全与签名基础设施要求，都将发生变化。该方案目前仍属提案，因此对交易所准入资格或流动性的实际影响，取决于尚未最终敲定的规则制定进程。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through market access and custody standards: if offshore venues can register with the CFTC under a federal option, the terms on which U.S. users reach offshore liquidity, and the cybersecurity and signing-infrastructure requirements those venues face, would both change. The proposal remains a proposal, so any effect on venue eligibility or liquidity is contingent on rulemaking that has not been finalized.

updates.title_zh: 【币安：已覆盖约 80% 的损失，正在用公司资金购买代币以全额弥补损失】
updates.title_en: 【币安：已覆盖约 80% 的损失，正在用公司资金购买代币以全额弥补损失】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安表示已覆盖约80%的黑客损失，并称未来几天将重点恢复提现、通过储备金证明加强透明度、追回被冻结资金并发布事件分析报告；初步调查仍未发现钱包私钥泄露证据。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance said it has covered about 80% of the hack losses and that in the coming days it will focus on restoring withdrawals, strengthening transparency via proof of reserves, recovering frozen funds, and publishing an incident analysis; the preliminary investigation has still found no evidence of wallet private-key leakage.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约64亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；币安称已覆盖约80%损失，已拨出超63.4亿美元（含50亿美元代币）用于全额补偿，约30亿美元被盗资金已在链上冻结，并正通过场外交易等方式购买剩余代币；FBI 与特勤局参与，TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将其归因于朝鲜关联组织 TraderTraitor；Circle 与 Tether 分别冻结约8.23亿美元 USDC 和约9.751亿美元 USDT；调查发现除被入侵的 DevOps 工程师笔记本电脑外还有“更多入侵点”，但尚未发现钱包私钥泄露证据；CFTC 主席借此推动离岸交易所接受美国监管。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.4B hack remains under investigation; Binance says it has covered about 80% of losses, allocated over $6.34B including $5B in tokens for full compensation, about $3B in stolen funds has been frozen on-chain, and it is buying remaining tokens via OTC and other means; the FBI and Secret Service are involved, and TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed it to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor; Circle and Tether froze about $823M in USDC and $975.1M in USDT respectively; the investigation found “additional points of breach” beyond the compromised DevOps engineer's laptop but no evidence of wallet private-key leakage; the CFTC chair is citing the hack to push for U.S. oversight of offshore exchanges.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance said it has covered about 80% of losses from a security incident, allocating more than $6.34B in SAFU and corporate funds and buying tokens to fully compensate users, while $3B in stolen funds has been frozen on-chain.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance said it has covered about 80% of losses from a security incident, allocating more than $6.34B in SAFU and corporate funds and buying tokens to fully compensate users, while $3B in stolen funds has been frozen on-chain.

updates.title_zh: 精彩片段：币安联席CEO：攻击者使用了自毁机制，导致
updates.title_en: Highlight Clip: Binance Co-CEO: Attackers Used Self-Destruct Mechanisms, Making
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安联合 CEO Richard Teng 进一步披露，攻击者利用 EIP-7702 在币安正常审批控制之外取得热钱包链上执行权限，并使用自毁机制清除工具和痕迹；币安暂停提现以重建和测试系统，目标在 40 小时内恢复，同时与执法部门合作追回资金。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance Co-CEO Richard Teng further disclosed that attackers used EIP-7702 to obtain on-chain execution authority over a hot wallet outside Binance's normal approval controls and used self-destruct mechanisms to erase tools and traces; Binance paused withdrawals to rebuild and test systems, targeting restoration within 40 hours, while working with law enforcement to recover funds.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安仍在处理这起创纪录的约 63 亿美元黑客事件，已用公司资金补充约 90% 被盗资产；调查披露攻击者通过 EIP-7702 绕过正常审批控制取得热钱包执行权限并使用自毁机制清除痕迹，币安暂停提现以重建系统并目标 40 小时内恢复；FBI 已公开将攻击归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor。
updates.current_state_en: Binance is still handling the record ~$6.3 billion hack and has replenished about 90% of stolen assets from company funds; the investigation disclosed that attackers used EIP-7702 to bypass normal approval controls and gain hot-wallet execution authority and used self-destruct mechanisms to erase traces, while Binance paused withdrawals to rebuild systems with a 40-hour restoration target; the FBI has publicly attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance Co-CEO Richard Teng said attackers behind the roughly $6.3 billion hot-wallet hack used EIP-7702 to obtain on-chain execution authority outside Binance's approval controls and self-destruct mechanisms to erase traces, as the exchange paused withdrawals and targeted system restoration within 40 hours while working with law enforcement to recover funds.
